paragraphs: On Thursday, Teacher Kim told the Explorers about a special guest. "Today Mia's mom visits us," she said. "She brings an experiment about soap." Leo made a small poster for the guest, and May wrote five questions in her notebook. Mia sat very straight and lifted her book to hide her face.

At one o'clock, the school secretary opened the library door. "Your guest is here, Teacher Kim," she said. A woman with a big bag walked in and waved at Mia. Mia looked at the table, and her face turned pink. "Hello, Explorers," said Mia's mom. "Mia talks about you every day." Mia pushed her chair back a little. Her mom put the bag on the table. She took out a plate, a bottle of water, and a piece of soap.

Teacher Kim asked the club to sit around the table. Mia's mom put a plate of water on the table and put some pepper on top. "The pepper is like the bad things on our hands," she said. "Is anybody able to push it away with a finger?" Leo put his finger in the water, and the pepper stayed on his finger. "Thank you for coming," he said in a polite way. "The water has no smell, and it is not clean now."

Then Mia's mom put a little soap on her finger. "Now watch the pepper," she said. She touched the water, and the pepper jumped away to the sides of the plate. "Wow!" said May. Everybody moved close to the table except Mia, who stayed far back. Lily watched Mia, but she did not say anything. Mia's mom looked at Mia. "Mia, you did this with me last week," she said. "Can you show your friends?"

Mia put down her book, stood up slowly, and walked to the table. She took the soap, and her hand did not move. The pepper jumped away again, and Leo clapped. "That is the best experiment this year," he said. The library had a pleasant smell of soap, and everybody talked at the same time. Among all the faces, Mia's face had the biggest smile. May asked all five questions, and Mia answered the first two. At the end, she carried her mom's bag to the door. "This is my mom," she said to the secretary.
text.summary: Mia's mom is the guest of the Explorers and shows a soap and pepper experiment. Mia stays small and quiet at first, but then she shows the experiment to her friends.
